fusions.name: Lidless Stare
fusions.desc: Your stare fixes on the first enemy in its path: it deals 12 damage and stuns the target for 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Unbroken Regard
fusions.desc: A look held on an enemy up to 8 tiles away deals 26 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach, and ignores resistances. The target is left [Marked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Sway
fusions.desc: Your swaying gaze holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds. When it lets go, they move 30% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Looks Away
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that fails to crit is rolled again, and the second roll stands.
